summary: Request to include runtime environment information (Node.js vs Bun, versions, cloud platforms like Vercel) in worker heartbeats to provide operational visibility. Should be opt-out and requires API and server coordination.
userImpact: Users will gain visibility into the runtime environment and versions their workers are operating in, helping with debugging and operational analysis.
proposedFix: Include runtime environment metadata in worker heartbeats, including Node.js vs Bun detection, version information, and cloud platform detection (e.g., Vercel). Make this opt-out by default.
keyQuote: It'll be useful to understand what runtime environment a worker is operating in now that we support bun.
